beforeSubmitPrompt.prompt:
You are a reminder hook. Inject guidance ONLY when the prompt is about coding, feature, or documentation.

If the prompt is about code/feature/doc, respond with:

"Skill reminder: Follow 7-phase workflow (A=Discover → B=Impact Analysis → C=Implement → D=Test → E=Docs → F=UML → G=Validate). HARD RULES: (1) 1 UC = 1 CD + 1 SD, (2) Skip Phase = defect, (3) No invented class/endpoint/permission, (4) Phase G = hard gate, (5) Code WITHOUT doc = .githooks/pre-commit will BLOCK. Source-of-truth: source code > docs > AI assumption."

If the prompt is conversational or not about code, respond with empty string to allow without reminder.

Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

stop.prompt: AI just stopped. Before declaring the task done, the Implementation Summary (templates/implementation-summary.md) MUST be filled with all 10 sections. Also: code change MUST be paired with doc change (rules/10-validation.md + .githooks/pre-commit drift detector). If you skip docs, the next `git commit` will be blocked. Always reference a UC-NN id in any summary or response.
